# HexaKode

> HexaKode is a software engineering and digital solutions studio based in Kerala, India, operating under a transparent, 100% remote-first model without corporate overhead. Founded by engineers, HexaKode delivers custom web platforms, mobile applications, UI/UX design, and technical digital marketing & SEO.

HexaKode connects clients directly with experienced software engineers to design, build, and scale high-performance digital products. This file provides an index of HexaKode's primary public pages, engineering capabilities, case studies, and informational resources for large language models and search engines.

## Company

- [HexaKode](https://hexakode.in): Official website homepage detailing core services, client guarantees, and engineering approach.
- [About Us & Our Story](https://hexakode.in/about): Company origin, founding leadership (Navaneeth P P and Prajosh C), remote-first operating model, and engineering culture.
- [Contact Us](https://hexakode.in/contact): Project consultations, engineering inquiries, and direct contact details.
- [Careers](https://hexakode.in/careers): Remote engineering roles and career opportunities at HexaKode.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://hexakode.in/services): Comprehensive directory of HexaKode's engineering, design, and growth services.
- [Web Development](https://hexakode.in/services/web-development): Custom full-stack web applications, enterprise portals, API engineering, and scalable cloud architectures.
- [Mobile App Development](https://hexakode.in/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform mobile app development for iOS and Android.
- [UI/UX Design](https://hexakode.in/services/ui-ux-design): User experience strategy, UI design systems, wireframing, and interactive design prototypes.
- [Digital Marketing](https://hexakode.in/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven technical SEO, search engine marketing, performance campaigns, and conversion optimization.

- [Portfolio Overview](https://hexakode.in/portfolio): Showcase of delivered client projects, enterprise solutions, and production software.
- [REVOPZ Energy Systems Website](https://hexakode.in/portfolio/revopz-website): Case study on designing and engineering a high-performance web platform for a renewable energy company.
- [REVOPZ Internal Management System](https://hexakode.in/portfolio/revopz-internal-management-system): Case study on architecting a custom operational management system and business workflow platform.
